theater: 高加索山區與里海西岸

battle.name: 俄國-波斯戰爭
battle.theater: 高加索山區與里海西岸
battle.brief: 一八〇四年三月起，俄羅斯帝國與卡扎爾波斯為高加索山區與里海西岸的控制權開戰。俄軍以火槍、刺刀與野戰砲列成方陣，硬擋基茲爾巴什騎兵的密集衝鋒；波斯步兵仍靠長矛列陣掩護火槍手，火槍射擊遲緩時以矛鋒近身搏鬥。卡牌這柄長槍，即波斯步軍在亞斯蘭杜茲與葉利薩維特波爾兩役的骨幹。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是俄羅斯帝國與卡扎爾波斯。俄方由聖彼得堡的戰爭衙門與外交委員會共同主導，前線則以新設立的喬治亞總督區經營：俄軍在一八〇一年兼併東格魯吉亞的梯弗利斯—卡赫提亞之後，把總督區當作南向基地，分遣隊由少將帕維爾·齊齊揚諾夫率領，配屬南方軍區的步兵營、哥薩克騎兵與輕炮兵；格魯吉亞親王亞歷山大·伊梅列提率領的格魯吉亞民兵編入先鋒行列，另有亞美尼亞武裝志願隊隨軍作戰。波方是法圖茲·沙汗統治的卡扎爾王朝，軍隊以阿塞拜疆總督侯賽因·庫利汗部的常備軍為骨幹，下轄基茲爾巴什騎兵、持矛與火槍的步兵營，輔以庫爾德、俾路支與阿富汗的部族部隊，受命者往往由沙汗或王子直接節制。戰區橫跨高加索山脈東西兩側：北面是達吉斯坦山區與謝赫城群，中段是卡爾巴赫、希拉萬通向里海的走廊，南面抵達基拉與蘭卡蘭的海岸線，並牽動第比利斯與埃里溫兩個樞紐。戰事自一八〇四年延續到一八一三年，其間一八〇七至一八一二年幾近停火，形成一段長期、低烈度而以據點、邊境巡騎與小股衝突為主的僵持。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Russian Empire and the Qajar state of Persia. On the Russian side policy was directed from Saint Petersburg by the war college and the foreign committee, while the front was administered from the newly created Georgian governorship: after annexing eastern Georgia, Tiflis and Kakheti, in 1801 Russia used that governorship as its southern base, and the expedition corps was led by Major General Pavel Tsitsianov with line infantry drawn from the southern military district, Cossack cavalry and light guns attached, the Georgian militia of Prince Alexander of Imereti placed in the van, and Armenian armed volunteers serving with the column. On the Persian side stood the armed forces of Fath-Ali Shah's Qajar dynasty, whose backbone was the standing army of Hossein Quli Khan, governor of Azerbaijan, with Qizilbash cavalry and infantry companies armed with long spears and muskets, supported by Kurdish, Baluch and Afghan tribal contingents, most of them under the direct orders of the shah or of the prince. The theatre stretched across both flanks of the Caucasus: the Dagestan mountains and the towns of Sheki in the north, the corridors through Karabakh and Shirvan that led down to the Caspian in the middle, the coast at Quba and Lankaran in the south, with Tiflis and Erivan as the two hinge towns. The war ran from 1804 to 1813, and between 1807 and 1812 it came close to a ceasefire, producing a long, low-intensity stalemate fought over fortresses, frontier posts and small columns of horse.
people: 波斯方面的決策核心是卡扎爾王朝的開國君主法圖茲·沙汗。他在一七九四年推翻賽法維王朝後，亟須證明新王朝對高加索諸汗國的支配權，因此把阿塞拜疆方面的軍事指揮交給自己的弟弟侯賽因·庫利汗，並以長子阿拔斯·米爾札作全軍統帥。侯賽因·庫利汗在亞斯蘭杜茲兵敗後退守希拉萬，阿拔斯·米爾札接手兵權，在葉利薩維特波爾再度失利；這位王子自此長期坐鎮高加索前線，日後在對俄與對奧的雙線戰爭中扮演主導角色，直到一八二六年病逝。俄羅斯方面最關鍵的指揮官是帕維爾·齊齊揚諾夫，他在三年內以有限兵力連敗對手，奪取德爾本特要塞與希拉萬要地，一般記載稱其一八〇六年獲封伯爵、同年病逝；其後由伊格納季·托爾馬索夫接管高加索軍團，葉爾莫洛夫再於一八〇九年後接手，以高壓手段推行俄式治理。高加索本地出身的伊梅列提親王在葉利薩維特波爾追擊時陣亡，說明俄軍在破碎山地中追擊的風險。波斯外交由米爾扎·阿布勒哈桑汗主持，一八一三年在古利斯坦談判中代表沙汗議約。真正左右天平的是英國政策：一八〇六至一八〇七年英國以歐洲局勢與商路利益為由向俄國施壓，促成停火，也是戰爭拖長並出現中斷的關鍵外力。
peopleEn: Decision making in Persia centred on Fath-Ali Shah, the founder of the Qajar dynasty. Having taken power by force in 1794, he needed to demonstrate that the new dynasty really held the Caucasian khanates, so he gave the military command in Azerbaijan to his brother Hossein Quli Khan and kept the overall army in the hands of his eldest son Abbas Mirza. After the defeat at Aslanduz, Hossein Quli Khan withdrew into Shirvan and Abbas Mirza assumed command, only to be beaten again at Yelisavetpol; from then on the prince remained at the Caucasian front for the rest of his life, directing both the war against Russia and the later campaigns against the Ottomans until his death in 1826. On the Russian side the decisive commander was Pavel Tsitsianov, who within three years defeated the enemy repeatedly with limited forces, took the fortress of Derbent and the key strongholds of Shirvan, was raised to the rank of count in 1806 according to the usual accounts and died of illness the same year. Ignaty Tormasov succeeded him in the Caucasus in 1807, and Yermolov took over the Georgian corps after 1809, imposing a much harder Russian administration. Alexander of Imereti, a Georgian prince in Russian service, was killed while pursuing the enemy at Yelisavetpol, which showed the risk of pursuit in broken mountain country. Persian diplomacy was handled by Mirza Abolhassan Khan, who represented the shah in the negotiations that produced the Treaty of Gulistan in 1813. The decisive outside factor was British policy: between 1806 and 1807 London pressed Russia to abandon the Caucasus on European and commercial grounds, and that pressure was the key external reason the war dragged on and was interrupted.
kits: 卡牌上的兵器是長槍，即歐洲與西亞通用的長柄矛。這件武器在十八、十九世紀之交並未從戰場上消失，只是位置轉移了：在俄羅斯帝國，彼得一世於十八世紀初已廢除步兵長矛，改以火槍配刺刀（刺刀在一七八〇年代末期列裝），因此俄軍方陣的骨架其實是刺刀線，卡牌上「方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面」那種典型排法，在俄軍身上是由刺刀與架立的火槍重新演出來的。真正仍把長矛當制式裝備的是波斯一方。卡扎爾步兵以長矛（波斯語稱尼耶扎，配短劍與小盾）為主力兵種，稱為提里什；其火槍是沉重而遲緩的托萬式火繩槍與長身火槍，多半架在支架上齊射，射擊節奏遠慢於俄軍的燧發滑膛槍，因此步兵線通常排成「長矛在前、火槍在後」的縱深，靠矛林擋住騎兵衝鋒，等火槍打完一輪再向前躍進。波斯騎兵用騎槍與標槍，並配手槍與彎刀。雙方火炮都是野戰砲：俄軍帶有十二磅與六磅的輕型野戰砲，數目不多但射擊準確，是決定亞斯蘭杜茲與葉利薩維特波爾兩役勝負的關鍵；波斯砲隊較小、銅鑄、靠馬匹牽引，多用於隨軍護衛與遠程騷擾。運輸上，波斯的山地分隊大量使用駱駝馱載給養，俄軍則依賴牛車車隊沿少數山路緩慢推進，這是俄軍深入後最容易被切斷的一環。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the pike, the long-shafted spear common to Europe and West Asia. By the turn of the nineteenth century it had not vanished from the battlefield, it had only changed its place. In the Russian Empire Peter the Great abolished infantry pikes early in the eighteenth century and replaced them with musket and bayonet, the bayonet becoming regulation in the late 1780s, so the spine of the Russian battalion was in fact a bayonet line, and the arrangement described on the card, pikes in front and musketeers behind, reappeared in Russian practice through bayonets and stacked muskets. The side that still carried the pike as standard equipment was Persia. Qajar infantry were organised around the long spear, the Persian neyza, used with a short sword and a small shield, and were known as the tirish; their firearms were heavy, slow matchlocks and long-barrelled muskets, mostly fired from rests, and their rate of fire was far below that of the Russian flintlock smoothbores. The infantry line was therefore normally arranged in depth with spears forward and muskets behind, the forest of spears screening the musketeers from cavalry, and the line stepping forward to close after each volley. Persian cavalry used lances and javelins together with pistols and curved sabres. Both sides fought with field artillery: the Russians brought light twelve-pounder and six-pounder guns, few in number but well served, and their fire decided the battles of Aslanduz and Yelisavetpol; the Persian guns were fewer, cast in bronze and drawn by horses, and served mostly as escort and for long-range harassment. In logistics the Persian columns relied heavily on camel trains to carry supply through the mountains, while the Russians depended on ox-drawn wagons moving slowly along the few usable passes, the part of any deep Russian advance that was easiest to cut.
tactics: 一八〇四年三月三十一日的亞斯蘭杜茲之戰（按俄曆與新曆換算另有四月之說），勝負由地形與砲兵決定。波斯軍沿阿斯蘭杜茲河谷的高地展開，試圖切斷通往北方的道路；齊齊揚諾夫選擇谷口兩側的坡地布陣，把野戰砲放在居高臨下的位置，先以齊射迫騎兵散開，再以步兵方陣頂住正面衝擊。基茲爾巴什騎兵分成數波反覆衝鋒，每次都撞在刺刀線與火槍輪射上，最後在俄騎兵反衝與砲火夾擊下退散；波斯步軍的矛陣失去掩護後被驅散，軍心隨之崩潰。葉利薩維特波爾之戰（一八〇四年六月十二日）則是相反的劇本：波斯軍主動後撤引誘俄軍追擊，俄軍先鋒在山谷中被回身反擊的波斯騎兵包抄，陣腳大亂，格魯吉亞親王伊梅列提陣亡；齊齊揚諾夫集結預備隊與炮兵，重新建立射擊線，才把波斯軍逐出戰場。整體而言，俄軍的戰術是「以固守求消耗」：用方陣頂住衝鋒，以砲火支援反擊，用車隊確保補給；波斯的戰術則以騎兵機動與假退卻製造局部優勢，趁俄軍隊形鬆散時打擊其側翼。一八一二年底奧地利戰爭爆發後，波斯轉為守勢反攻；一八一三年春俄軍分路推進蘭卡蘭，以圍城壕溝與攻城砲逼降守軍，隨後在布拉克盧之役以砲火配合騎兵兩翼包抄，擊潰阿拔斯·米爾札的解圍軍。
tacticsEn: The battle of Aslanduz on 31 March 1804 (other dates in April follow from the difference between the Russian and the new calendar) was decided by ground and artillery. The Persian army deployed along the heights of the Aslanduz valley in an attempt to cut the road to the north; Tsitsianov chose the slopes on both sides of the valley mouth and placed his field guns on the commanding ground, breaking the cavalry with salvoes and then meeting the frontal charge with a close order infantry square. The Qizilbash cavalry charged again and again, each time into a bayonet line and a volley of musketry, and finally broke up under the Russian counter-charge and the guns; the Persian spear line lost its cover, was driven back and the army's morale broke with it. The battle of Yelisavetpol on 12 June 1804 was the opposite scenario: the Persian army retired deliberately to draw the Russians into pursuit, then turned and enveloped the Russian vanguard in the valley, and the column came apart, Prince Alexander of Imereti being killed in the confusion; only by rallying his reserves and guns and re-establishing a line of fire did Tsitsianov drive the Persians off the field. In general the Russian method was one of holding and wearing down: a square to absorb the charge, artillery to support the counter-stroke, wagon trains to protect the supply line. The Persian method was mobility and feigned retreat, creating local superiority and striking the flanks while the Russian formation was loose. After the Austrian war broke out at the end of 1812 Persia went on the defensive, and in the spring of 1813 the Russians advanced in columns towards Lankaran, forced the garrison to surrender with trenches and siege guns, and then at the battle of Bulaklu used artillery together with a cavalry attack on both wings to destroy the relieving army of Abbas Mirza.
data: 這場戰爭的具體數字多數來自俄方與波方互不相符的戰報，引用時必須保留。亞斯蘭杜茲一役，常見記載是俄軍出動約三千五百人（含騎兵與砲隊），波斯軍約六千人，亦有上萬之說；葉利薩維特波爾一役，俄軍兵力常記為四千至五千，波斯軍則記為一萬左右。傷亡方面，葉利薩維特波爾俄軍的損失多記為數百至近千人，波斯軍折損亦達數百至千餘，各家數字互相矛盾，本卡只採「以百計至以千計」這種概略說法。德爾本特要塞於一八〇四年六月向俄軍投降，蘭卡蘭於一八一三年春陷落，兩處守軍皆為數百至千餘人規模。時間上，戰爭自一八〇四年打到一八一三年，前後約九年，其中一八〇七至一八一二年間為中斷期，真正高強度的交火集中在頭一年與最後兩年。距離方面，亞斯蘭杜茲至德爾本特約數十公里，葉利薩維特波爾至甘賈不過一日行程，正好說明俄軍為何能連續奪取後方要塞。產能方面，波斯方面的常備軍與火槍產量遠低於俄羅斯，長矛、白刃與騎兵成了它低廉的替代；俄軍則能倚仗本土兵工廠供應燧發滑膛槍與砲彈。古利斯坦條約涉及贖金與商貿的具體金額，各文本所載出入頗大，本卡不列數目。
dataEn: The figures for this war come mostly from Russian and Persian reports that do not agree with one another, so they must be used with caution. At Aslanduz the Russian force is commonly given as about 3,500 men including cavalry and guns, against some 6,000 Persians, though some accounts put the Persian number at ten thousand or more; at Yelisavetpol the Russian strength is usually given as four to five thousand against about ten thousand Persians. Casualties at Yelisavetpol are recorded as several hundred to nearly a thousand for the Russians and several hundred to over a thousand for the Persians, and the various figures contradict each other, so this card uses the general phrase of hundreds to thousands. The fortress of Derbent surrendered to the Russians in June 1804 and Lankaran fell in the spring of 1813, both defended by garrisons of several hundred to over a thousand men. In time the war ran from 1804 to 1813, about nine years, of which 1807 to 1812 was an interruption, the real heavy fighting being concentrated in the first year and in the last two. In distance, Aslanduz and Derbent are only some tens of kilometres apart, and Yelisavetpol is a single day's march from Ganja, which explains how the Russians could seize one fortress after another behind the front. In production terms the standing army and the musket output of Persia were far below those of Russia, and the pike, the sabre and the horse served as cheap substitutes; the Russians could rely on home arsenals for flintlock muskets and gunpowder. The sums and commercial clauses attached to the Treaty of Gulistan differ considerably between texts, and this card therefore quotes no figures.
cause: 打起來的原因很直接：俄羅斯先把格魯吉亞拿到手，波斯不肯認。一八〇〇年格魯吉亞末代王喬治十二世在亞森庫爾斯克退位，俄軍隨即干涉，一八〇一年俄羅斯兼併梯弗利斯—卡赫提亞並設立總督區，把防線推到阿拉斯河與庫拉河的上游，等於直接插進卡扎爾波斯與里海之間。法圖茲·沙汗的卡扎爾王朝靠一七九四年的攻佔入主，政權根基來自武裝力量與西北部部族的支持，他必須證明自己能對高加索諸汗國與阿塞拜疆總督區行使權力，否則新王朝在邊境上只是前任留下的殘影。加上波斯把里海視為自己的內海，一旦俄國取得里海西岸的岸線並在海中維持艦隊，東向通往印度與波斯灣的商路就會被掐住，喀什方向的貨源也會流失。宗教層面上，什葉派與遜尼派在高加索的角逐，使不少山區穆民寧願依附俄羅斯的保護。更深一層，亞歷山大一世的歐洲改革與法國戰爭吸走了俄國的注意力，加上英國在一八〇一年後迅速與俄國和解，並在一八〇六至一八〇七年以干擾法國戰爭為由要求俄國放棄高加索，戰事因此被人為拉長。至於卡扎爾朝廷內部派系是否需要一場對外勝利來穩住軍心，各家說法不一，史載有限。
causeEn: The reason for the war is direct: Russia took Georgia first, and Persia would not accept it. In 1800 the last king of Georgia, George XII, abdicated at Askurisk under Russian pressure, Russian troops intervened, and in 1801 Russia annexed Tiflis and Kakheti and set up a governorship, pushing its line up the Araxes and the Kura, that is, directly between the Qajar state and the Caspian. The Qajar dynasty of Fath-Ali Shah had come to power by conquest in 1794, and its base was military force and support from the tribes of the north-west, so the shah had to show that he could exercise authority over the Caucasian khanates and the governorship of Azerbaijan; otherwise the new dynasty was only the shadow of the old one on the frontier. Persia also regarded the Caspian as an inland sea of its own, and once Russia held the western shore and kept a fleet there, the trade route eastwards towards India and the Persian Gulf would be pinched shut and the goods coming from Kashgar would be lost. Religiously, the Shia and Sunni contest in the Caucasus pushed many mountain Muslims to prefer Russian protection. At a deeper level, Alexander I's European reforms and the war against France absorbed Russian attention, and after Britain reconciled with Russia in 1801 it pressed Moscow between 1806 and 1807 to abandon the Caucasus on the grounds that it was interfering with the French war, which artificially prolonged the fighting. Whether the Qajar court also needed a foreign victory to steady its factions is a matter of competing claims, and the record here is thin.
impact: 一八一三年古利斯坦條約之後，高加索的天平整體倒向俄羅斯。俄國取得達吉斯坦，並吞了巴庫、傑爾賓特、希拉萬、甘賈與卡爾巴赫諸汗國，波斯只保留庫拉河與阿拉斯河以南的埃里溫、納希切萬等領地以及部分卡爾巴赫高地的內部自治；條約還讓俄國取得在里海維持艦隊的專屬權，這是彼得大帝時代以來俄國最想要的一張牌，也是後來里海艦隊與巴庫石油的源頭。對波斯而言，代價不只在土地：沙室的威信、國庫與軍隊士氣都受重創，南方對奧地利的防線因此收緊，一八二六至一八二八年的俄波戰爭幾乎是這場敗局的延伸。對高加索諸汗國與山區民族而言，一個新的強權進駐山區，帶來收稅、設官與改宗壓迫，此後半個世紀的衝突最終演成一八一七至一八六四年的高加索戰爭。俄國在南方獲得天然盟友、馬匹與軍用補給點後，重新把注意力投向波蘭與歐洲，一八一三年維也納會議前夕的歐洲局勢因此多了一個不穩定的南翼變數，而莫斯科與倫敦之間摩擦的來源之一也從此固定下來。
impactEn: After the Treaty of Gulistan in 1813 the balance of the Caucasus tipped wholesale towards Russia. Russia took Dagestan and absorbed the khanates of Baku, Derbent, Shirvan, Ganja and Karabakh, while Persia kept only Erivan, Nakhichevan and other lands south of the Kura and the Araxes, together with internal autonomy over part of the Karabakh highlands. The treaty also gave Russia the exclusive right to keep a fleet on the Caspian, the single card Moscow had wanted since the time of Peter the Great, and the origin of the later Caspian flotilla and of the Baku oil. For Persia the cost was not only territorial: the prestige of the shah's house, the treasury and the morale of the army were all damaged, the southern front against the Ottomans tightened, and the Russo-Persian War of 1826 to 1828 was in effect an extension of this defeat. For the Caucasian khanates and the mountain peoples a new power had settled in the highlands, bringing taxation, appointed officials and pressure to change faith, and the conflicts of the following half century grew into the Caucasian War of 1817 to 1864. Having gained allies, horses and supply in the south, Russia turned her attention back to Poland and to Europe, adding one more unstable southern variable to the situation before the Congress of Vienna in 1813 and fixing one of the standing sources of friction between Moscow and London.
result: 結果是俄國完勝，而卡扎爾王朝退守亞美尼亞與亞塞拜疆南部。亞斯蘭杜茲與葉利薩維特波爾兩戰奠定北線主動權，德爾本特與甘賈的淪陷打開通往里海的道路；一八〇六至一八一二年的中斷只是英國施壓下的喘息，並未改變大勢；一八一三年春，分路推進的俄軍攻下蘭卡蘭，布拉克盧之役擊潰阿拔斯·米爾札的解圍軍後，波斯求和。十月簽訂的古利斯坦條約（簽訂日期史載有十月十二日與十月二十四日兩種記法）割讓了絕大多數高加索汗國，並把里海艦隊權與對外貿易權讓予俄國。阿拔斯·米爾札雖保住性命與地盤，卻眼見哥哥的江山被切開；此後他把重心轉向西部邊境，鼓勵游擊與消耗，等待下一次機會。從兵器史的角度看，這場戰爭同時是一次長矛的退場與刺刀的接管：波斯步兵仍靠矛與火繩槍的組合勉強維持戰鬥力，而火槍射速與陣形韌性的差距，終究不是靠騎兵與地形可以補回來的。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Russian victory and the withdrawal of the Qajar dynasty into Armenia and southern Azerbaijan. The two battles of Aslanduz and Yelisavetpol gave Russia the initiative on the northern front, and the fall of Derbent and Ganja opened the road to the Caspian; the interruption of 1806 to 1812 was only a respite forced by British pressure and changed nothing. In the spring of 1813 the Russians advanced in columns, took Lankaran and destroyed the relieving army of Abbas Mirza at the battle of Bulaklu, after which Persia asked for terms. The Treaty of Gulistan, signed in October (the date appears in the record as either 12 or 24 October), ceded the great majority of the Caucasian khanates and handed Russia the right to a Caspian fleet and to foreign trade. Abbas Mirza kept his life and his ground but saw his brother's dominions cut in two; he turned afterwards to the western frontier and to a war of raids and attrition, waiting for the next opening. From the point of view of the history of arms, the war was at once the retirement of the pike and the takeover of the bayonet: Persian infantry still held out with spear and matchlock, and the difference in rate of fire and in the resilience of formations could not in the end be made up by cavalry and by favourable ground.
